    z.extractall(package)
plugin=package/'verity-plane';wheel=plugin/'packages'/expected['archive_name']
assert hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected['archive_sha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:
    n=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('/ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md.tpl'))
    entry=z.read(n).decode().replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}','Plugin qualification').replace('{{HARNESS_VERSION}}','0.21.0')
digest=hashlib.sha256(entry.encode()).hexdigest();report['entry_sha256']=digest;report['wheel']=expected

    report['commands'].append({'label':label,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(parent),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr});flush()
    assert r.returncode in allowed,(label,r.stdout[-1200:],r.stderr[-1200:])
    return r.stdout
def assess(contexts):

def prepare_and_activate(session,data):
    remote=root/'source';remote.mkdir()

    for args in [['init'],['add','.'],['-c','user.name=Fixture','-c','user.email=fixture@example.invalid','commit','-m','Disposable exact-wheel selection']]:
        run('fixture-git',['git','-C',remote,*args])
    repo=parent/'clone'
    run('clone-after-startup',['git','clone',remote,repo]);assert not (repo/'ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md').exists()
    before={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in repo.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
    activation=json.loads(run('activate-observed-session',[sys.executable,'-I',plugin/'scripts/activate.py','--host',mode,'--session-id',session,'--data-root',data,'--target',repo]))
    assert activation['status']=='available';assess([activation['content']])
    report['selection']={'session_id':session,'data':str(data),'repository':str(repo),'before':before}

# Fresh-session recovery: ordinary read-only prompts, unchanged candidate/model.
report['authorization'] = 'Human mmzen: You can do it, for the proposed fresh-session recovery and support-report preparation.'
report['diagnostic_changes'] = ['new native session and disposable checkout', 'ordinary code/data questions instead of metadata/acknowledgement probes', 'documented auto-compact window only; no percentage override']

report['repository_head'] = '8e8b43ad28184fa2744071d1626d354661c5929e'
report['timing_documentation'] = 'https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#set-the-auto-compact-window'
repo=None;before=None

def native(phase,prompt,session=None):
    argv=[EXES['claude']['executable'],'--print','--verbose','--output-format','stream-json','--include-hook-events','--tools','','--strict-mcp-config','--permission-prompts','none','--setting-sources','project','--settings','{}','--plugin-dir',str(plugin),'--model','opus']
    if session: argv += ['--resume',session]
    local=dict(env)
    overrides={'CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW':'100000'} if session else {}
    local.update(overrides)
    started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    try:
        r=subprocess.run(argv,input=prompt,cwd=parent,env=local,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=240)
        stdout,stderr,rc=r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        stdout=exc.stdout or '';stderr=exc.stderr or ''
        if isinstance(stdout,bytes):stdout=stdout.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        if isinstance(stderr,bytes):stderr=stderr.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        rc=124
    contexts=[];events=[];replies=[];ident=None;models=[]
    for line in stdout.splitlines():
        try:e=json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:continue
        if e.get('session_id'):ident=e['session_id']
        if e.get('type')=='system' and e.get('subtype')=='init':
            models.append(e.get('model'));events.append(e)
        if e.get('subtype')=='hook_response':
            events.append(e)
            try:c=json.loads(e.get('output','{}')).get('hookSpecificOutput',{}).get('additionalContext')
            except ValueError:c=None
            if c:contexts.append(c)
        if e.get('subtype')=='compact_boundary':events.append(e)
        if e.get('type')=='assistant':replies += [c['text'] for c in e.get('message',{}).get('content',[]) if c.get('type')=='text']
        if e.get('type')=='result':events.append(e)
    errors=[e.get('result') for e in events if e.get('is_error')]
    triggers=[e.get('compact_metadata',{}).get('trigger') for e in events if e.get('subtype')=='compact_boundary']
    stage={'phase':phase,'started_at':started,'argv':argv,'stdin':prompt,'cwd':str(parent),'environment_overrides':overrides,'exit_code':rc,'session_id':ident,'contexts':contexts,'events':events,'replies':replies,'models':models,'provider_errors':errors,'compaction_triggers':triggers,'stdout':stdout,'stderr':stderr}
    report['stages'].append(stage);flush()
    print(json.dumps({'phase':phase,'exit_code':rc,'model':models,'compaction_triggers':triggers,'errors':errors}),flush=True)
    assert rc==0 and ident and not errors,{'phase':phase,'exit_code':rc,'errors':errors}
    if session:assert ident==session,('session changed',ident,session)
    return ident,contexts,events

try:
    report['version']=run('host-version',[EXES['claude']['executable'],'--version']).strip()
    assert report['version']=='2.1.273 (Claude Code)', 'Host version changed: inspect before qualifying'
    session,contexts,_=native('fresh-startup','In Python, what does sorted([3, 1, 2]) return? Answer in one sentence. Do not use tools.')
    assert any('# Select the working repository' in c for c in contexts)
    text='\n'.join(contexts)
    declared=re.findall(r'(?m)^Plugin data: (.+)$',text);assert len(declared)==1
    data=Path(declared[0]);assert data.is_relative_to(Path(env['CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'])/'plugins/data') and session in text
    repo,before=prepare_and_activate(session,data)
    _,contexts,events=native('fresh-selected-code-review','Review this Python function for empty-list behavior: def average(values): return sum(values) / len(values). State the edge case and one suitable correction in two sentences. Do not use tools or edit files.',session)
    assess(contexts)
    report['automatic_compaction_observed']=False
    # Bounded ordinary analysis of generated, non-sensitive inventory data.
    # Distinct batches grow conversation context; no manual compact command is used.
    for batch in range(1,7):
        rows=['sku,category,quantity,unit_price']
        categories=['notebook','pencil','folder','envelope']
        for i in range(1600):
            index=(batch-1)*1600+i
            rows.append(f'SKU-{index:06d},{categories[i%4]},{1+i%40},{1+i%12}.{i%100:02d}')
        prompt=('Check this synthetic stationery inventory CSV without using tools or editing files. '
                'Report the column names, the first and last SKU, and whether quantities contain a negative value. '
                'Keep the answer to three short bullets.\n\n'+'\n'.join(rows))
        _,contexts,events=native('inventory-batch-'+str(batch),prompt,session)
        assess(contexts)
        if any(e.get('subtype')=='compact_boundary' and e.get('compact_metadata',{}).get('trigger')=='auto' for e in events):

except Exception as exc:

finally:

        if not report['repository_preserved']:report['passed']=False
    report['completed_at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    flush()
print(json.dumps({'passed':report['passed'],'error':report.get('error'),'report':str(dest)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if report['passed'] else 1)
